name: ai-native-sdlc
description: Take a Linear, GitLab, or GitHub task to a reviewed, opened MR/PR: plan from the board, design, build test-first and typed, review with an independent subagent, and stop at the MR/PR. Deterministic checks prove each test fails without the change, mutants on the changed lines die, risky callers are covered, and nothing is suppressed silently; a gate hook blocks merges and publishing with failing checks.
